jobInfo.postDescription:
Junior Tester
Department :  Vehicle Sales Solutions (BP15885)

This position is for the VS&M and MDM in UD Trucks. Core responsibility of the team is to deliver IT Services to Truck Sales area and MDM area within UD, where Testing is critical to secure the delivery quality. Resources are required to work as Test Consultants for long term/ short term assignments, working closely with local as well as global teams. Following requirement will need a person who is flexible to work on both Manual and Automated Testing. 

Main responsibility:

Writing test case in English guided by test lead/manager
Perform test activities during customer solution delivery, e.g. Functional test, e2e test, UAT test, integration test and smoke test


Minimum qualifications

Good English communication.

Familiar with one of the test lifecycle tools: MS DevOps
Understanding/ contribution to preparation of Test Plan and Test estimations 
Good skills in Test Case design/ execution and Defect analysis, Defect tracking/ management 
Hands-on experience in System Integration testing
Hands-on experience in API testing
SQL knowledge is mandatory, ability to write/run queries
Analysing Test Scenarios and design/write performance test script is a plus
Analysing Test Scenarios and design/ convert to automation scripts is a plus
Real time experience in Agile methodology
